caption: The drawing depicts a wooden framework composed of vertical and horizontal planks with a roughly rectangular base for stability, all rendered in tones of weathered grayish-blue with hints of brown and woodgrain texture. Mounted in the center is a horizontal axis supporting two semi-circular wooden arms, forming a partial wheel shape. Attached to both the top and bottom edges of these arms are multiple small, bell-shaped metal objects, colored in a muted yellow-gold shade, evenly spaced around the arcs. One side of the structure features a protruding handlebar parallel to the axis, suggesting it can be turned manually. The background is plain and off-white, with a small, handwritten signature “Bertha Semple” in the lower right corner.
title: Mission Chimes
